vulnerable_statements.reason: vcap_free_rule(rule) has already freed the rule (and its internal structure), so dereferencing rule->keyfields reads freed memory (use-after-free).
Same freed rule object is dereferenced again to read rule->actionfields after vcap_free_rule(), a use-after-free read.

suggested_fix: Do not access the rule after calling vcap_free_rule(). Remove the post-free checks of rule->keyfields and rule->actionfields (and the pointless non-NULL check), or do these list checks before freeing the rule. If the test needs to confirm that the lists get emptied, check that in a way that doesn't touch the freed object.
